description.text: The last set of the Sword & Shield series, a special set released on 20 January 2023 to celebrate the era of Pokémon V. It has 160 cards, 159 and a secret rare, and the Galarian Gallery, a subset of 70 cards with special artwork. Zacian and Zamazenta return with VSTAR Powers, and Charizard appears both as a Pokémon VSTAR and as a Radiant Pokémon, among eight VSTAR, five VMAX and three Radiant Pokémon.

description.text: The Champion copy of Friends in Hisui, stamped for the winner of a Professor Cup. Professor Cups are fun-format tournaments held through the year for Pokémon Professors, usually those at Stage 1 and above. Professor Cup promos have usually come in regular, Staff, Top 8 and Champion versions.
